purpose: The E1 freeze receipt pins the exact source that produced the E1 evidence. WP13 is closed and WP14 is authorized to develop, so those files can legitimately change. Every divergence must be declared here with the frozen hash and a commit the frozen bytes are still recoverable from, so the E1 provenance chain stays complete and auditable.

divergences.reason: Adds the opt-in solverExecution.skipConstantObjectiveLevels flag and the retained-portfolio-full-witness-v1 evidence profile. Both default to off, so the frozen E1 configurations keep the exact behaviour and evidence their receipts recorded.
